title: DNF Friedgut degree
statement: For a natural number $w$ and a real number $\varepsilon$, define the DNF Friedgut degree to be the natural-number ceiling of $30w$ times the switching depth for parameter $\varepsilon$.
caveat: The supplied context does not define the switching depth.
